collections.name: users
collections.description: Stores user profiles including their role, details, and networking preferences.

fields.name: interests
fields.description: Array of student interest and goal strings

fields.name: collaborationStatus
fields.description: Status indicating availability for hackathons, projects, etc.

access.read: Authenticated users can read any profile.
access.create: Authenticated users can create their own profile.
access.update: Users can only update their own profile.

collections.name: posts
collections.description: Stores social posts made by users.

access.read: Authenticated users can read all posts.
access.create: Authenticated users can create posts with their own authorId.
access.update: Users can update likes, or their own posts.
access.delete: Users can delete their own posts.

fields.name: participants
fields.description: Array of user UIDs involved in the chat

fields.name: lastMessage
fields.description: Preview of the last message sent

access.read: Authenticated users who are in the participants array can read.
access.create: Authenticated users can create chats if they are in the participants array.
access.update: Participants can update the chat (e.g. lastMessage).

collections.name: messages
collections.description: Stores individual messages within a chat.

access.read: Authenticated users who are participants in the parent chat can read.
access.create: Authenticated users who are participants in the parent chat can create messages.

collections.name: project_showcases
collections.description: Stores ongoing student projects shared in the showcase.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Brief description of the ongoing project

fields.name: technologies
fields.description: Technology stack tags used in the project

fields.name: lookingForRoles
fields.description: Open roles or skills needed for collaboration

fields.name: starsCount
fields.description: Number of stars given to project

access.create: Authenticated users can create showcase projects.
access.update: Authors can update their projects, authenticated users can star.

collections.name: project_collaborations
collections.description: Stores collaboration requests sent by users to project owners.

fields.name: projectId
fields.description: ID of the target showcase project

fields.name: applicantUid
fields.description: UID of user offering to collaborate

fields.name: role
fields.description: Role applicant wishes to contribute (e.g. Frontend, AI)

access.read: Project author and applicant can read.
access.create: Authenticated users can create collaboration requests.
